body.input: What are the latest stable Julia releases?

content.text:
The latest releases of the Julia programming language are divided between the **current stable release** and the **Long-Term Support (LTS) release**:

* **Current Stable Release:** **v1.13.1**
  * This is the recommended version for most developers and general users who want the newest language features, performance improvements, and standard library updates.
* **Long-Term Support (LTS) Release:** **v1.10.12** (v1.10 series)
  * The LTS release is intended for enterprise environments or organizations that require maximum stability, certified upgrade paths, and minimal API/ecosystem churn, receiving ongoing critical bug and security fixes.

### Installation & Management
The recommended tool to install and manage these versions is [**`juliaup`**](https://github.com/JuliaLang/juliaup), which handles version switching (e.g., between `release` and `lts`) and updates automatically. Alternatively, standalone binaries and installers can be downloaded directly from the official [Julia Downloads page](https://julialang.org/downloads/).
